route: scripted (procedural Blender geometry, rig and keyed clips; no provider generation)

skin.policy: rigid: one bone per vertex at weight 1.0

rootMotion: code-owned: the root joint is never animated and every clip plays in place

frame.note: encounter.ts rotation.y = -heading turns local -Z onto the heading

references.note: P4-T2 concept sheet picked for the Cog Sentry (docs/art-bible.md)

materialsUsed: approved P4-T3 brass-polished and brass-aged sets bound by slot name at runtime, each sampled at one texel (constant UV) and tinted by its manifest slot tint (linear multiplier); gunmetal (gunmetal and jewels from COLOR_0) and sentry-glow are factor-only
license: Original work generated in Blender from a checked-in script; concept reference from Paul's paid Higgsfield plan (Terms of Use 4.4)

checks: reimport gate (weights, influences, clips, root motion, bounds, sockets)
evaluated pose checks (floor, death on the floor, loop seams)

approvals.evidence: docs/art-bible.md: sentry-sheet-1.png picked for the Cog Sentry

approvals.notes: review sheet ANIMATION sections (Blender frames and engine stills)
create-rigged-character-assets requires an independent >= 80/100 score; unscored means unaccepted

rubric.note: Up from 13. Front review render model-low-front.png (figure H 428 px, y115-543): head width 0.107 of height (concept 0.10), pauldron span 0.33 (concept 0.31), gunmetal waist 48 px so waist/shoulder 0.34 against the concept's ~0.32 (was 0.40), hands end at 0.61 of height (concept 0.62), hands now fingered at about 0.03 of height wide (was 0.014, concept 0.039), and long pointed sabatons replace the block feet. The side view now has a domed chest with real depth instead of a flat column. Still primitive in shape language: pauldrons are near-spheres and the cuirass is an egg dome, not the concept's angular layered pectoral plates; thighs are straight-sided cylinders with flat fronts, shins plain tapered cylinders with no calf swell, and the forearm bracers sit as two offset slabs. A visible break opens between thigh plate and knee in every standing pose: background shows through at y385-395 of 428 in the Blender front (2.3% of height) and y437-452 of 585 in engine idle.jpg (2.6%), and in p4-sentry-attack.jpg the knees read as detached from the thighs.

Up from 13. Present now: hex core in a pale bezel with a second small hex below it (glow-close.jpg x420-480, y328-399, median (247,187,76)); a lit amber channel as three pips down the ribbed gunmetal waist (x462-471, y438-491, median (245,191,74)); two horizontal amber eye slits under a brow bar (median (240,174,78)); exposed neck pistons (three rods in model-low-side.png); back gear medallion; faceted multi-colour jewel inlays on the upper arm and outer thigh. Jewels are small: 117 jewel pixels on the side render and 165 on the back, against 1800 and 2475 on the concept views, which is about 29-30% of the concept's area once scaled for figure height (428/905 px, area factor 0.22). Was 0. The head is a round helmet dome with a visor bar and a separate chin block, not the concept's narrow tapered faceless mask with brow and cheek planes. Core centre not white-hot (open item, noted not scored).

Up from 8. The wood-grain tileable is gone: brass is smooth polished metal with clean highlights, and lit faces no longer go cream (engine idle warm-metal p90 (214,173,119) against concept (203,163,102); the previous build was (202,173,143)). The chest carries a vertical keel seam, a horizontal belly band and plate breaks, and the waist is ribbed gunmetal. Elsewhere the surface is bare: thighs, shins, upper arms and forearms are unseamed cylinders with no panel lines, edge bevels or overlapping plate lips, which are the concept's main surface language, and the knees are plain dark discs rather than ribbed joint cylinders under a knee cop.

Up from 9. Warm-metal median, engine idle upper body (96,64,33), hue 30, L 0.25, S 0.49 (glow-close (93,62,31), same hue); concept front body (91,64,46), hue 24, L 0.27, S 0.33. Value matches and the hue gap closed from 11 to 6 degrees, but saturation is still 0.16 high (was 0.12 high), so the brass leans orange-ochre rather than the concept's dusty bronze. Highlight p90 now matches (214,173,119) vs (203,163,102). Eyes median (240,174,78), p95 (251,214,94) against concept eyes p90 (249,209,108): close. Core p95 (252,223,84) against the concept's white-hot p95 (254,249,162): open owner item. Jewel accent colour now exists (emerald, sapphire and ruby pixels in the side and back renders), though none read in the front-facing engine shots.

Up from 5. In idle.jpg and glow-close.jpg the lit hex core, eye slits and waist pips give three stacked amber focal points on a figure that separates cleanly from the dark wall, and the gunmetal waist pinch reads as a humanoid hourglass. Against that, the thigh-knee gap shows floor through the legs at 2-4 m so the lower legs look detached, and the spherical pauldrons and dome chest read as a toy robot more than the concept's armoured knight-automaton.

topFixes: Close the thigh-to-knee break: extend the thigh plates (cuisses) down over a ribbed gunmetal knee cylinder and add a brass knee cop so no background shows between thigh and shin in any standing or attack pose (now a 2.3-2.6% of height gap in model-low-front and engine idle).

Reshape the round primitives into the concept's angular plate shapes: flatten and layer the pauldrons into two or three overlapping curved shells with a lip instead of spheres, and break the egg-dome cuirass into faceted left and right pectoral plates with a sternum ridge around the hex core.

Give the limbs shape and seams: taper the thighs from a wide hip to the knee with a bevelled front ridge, swell the greaves at the calf, and add panel lines and overlapping plate edges on thighs, shins, upper arms and the forearm bracers (which should wrap the forearm as one tapered shell, not two offset slabs).

Rebuild the head as the concept's narrow faceless mask: taller than wide, tapering to a pointed chin, with brow and cheek planes, the eye slits cut into the mask itself, and the round helmet dome, visor bar and separate chin block removed.

Enlarge the jewel inlays about 3x in area (now about 30% of the concept's scaled jewel area) and add the faceted cut so they read on the outer thighs and upper arms at play distance; pull brass saturation from 0.49 toward 0.33 at the same value to reach the concept's dusty bronze (hue 30 to 24).
independentScore.method: Independent reviewer (did not build the asset) on 2026-11-16, scoring commit 0282e6b against the approved assets-source/concepts/sentry-sheet-1.png. Shape from the Blender review renders (model-low-front/side/back, model-high-three-quarter, cog-sentry.review-sheet.jpg); colour and glow from the in-engine shots staging/engine/{idle,glow-close,attack,hit,frozen,death}.jpg and docs/verification/p4-sentry-*.jpg. Stale p6-glow and xr-emu-15 images and author status files were not used. Proportions were read from 10 px gridded 2x crops of the front render and 20 px gridded crops of the concept front, normalised to figure height. Colours are Pillow/NumPy medians and top-percentile means over an HSV warm-metal mask (hue 15-55, S>0.3, V>0.12); glow over HSV masks (V>0.8, S>0.45, hue 25-60) inside tight core, eye and waist boxes; jewel pixels counted by HSV hue bands (S>0.4, V>0.25) and scaled by squared figure-height ratio. The previous independent score of 48 in provenance.json was used only to report deltas. The white-hot core centre is an open owner item and was noted but not scored down.
